examples.text: āraddhaṃ kho pana me, brāhmaṇa, vīriyaṃ ahosi asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ek'aggaṃ.
yesaṃ dhammā susammuṭṭhā, paravādesu nīyare, suttā te nappabujjhanti, kālo tesaṃ pabujjhitun'ti.

60901.meaning1: common knowledge; popular understanding; general consensus; conventional usage
60901.commentary: (SNPa) sammutiyo'ti diṭṭhiyo. puthujjā'ti puthujjanasambhavā. (NIDD1) sammutiyo'ti. sammutiyo vuccanti dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni diṭṭhisammutiyo.

examples.text: yathā hi aṅgasambhārā, hoti saddo ratho iti, evaṃ khandhesu santesu, hoti satto'ti sammuti.
na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā, na diṭṭhisārī na'pi ñāṇabandhu, ñatvā ca so sammutiyo puthujjā, upekkhatī uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

yathā, mahārāja, mahiyā rājaputtānaṃ hatthi-assaratha-dhanu-tharu-lekha-muddā-sikkhā-khagga-manta-suti-sammuti-yuddha-yujjhāpana-kiriyā karaṇīyā, avasesānaṃ puthu-vessa-suddānaṃ kasi vaṇijjā gorakkhā karaṇīyā
niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine ekarattam'pi ce bhikkhu ticīvarena vippavaseyya, aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

60905.commentary: (DNa) aññataro theranāmako bhikkhū'ti evaṃ theranāmako vā, yaṃ vā pana mahallakakāle pabbajitaṃ sāmaṇer'ādayo disvā thero thero'ti vadanti, ayaṃ sammutithero nāma.

examples.text: tayo therā, jātithero, dhammathero, sammutithero.

60910.synonym: attamana, abhiraddha, āmodita, patīta, pamudita, pamodita, pīṇita, matta, rata, vitta, sampahaṃsita, sukhita, somanassajāta

examples.text: bhavarāmāya vata, bho, pajāya bhavaratāya bhavasammuditāya samūlaṃ bhavaṃ udabbahī'ti.
cakkhuṃ kho, māgaṇḍiya, rūp'ārāmaṃ rūparataṃ rūpasammuditaṃ. taṃ tathāgatassa dantaṃ guttaṃ rakkhitaṃ saṃvutaṃ, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.

60912.meaning1: is bewildered; is confused; is perplexed

examples.text: sammuyhāmi pamuyhāmi, sabbā muyhanti me disā, petaṃ taṃ sāmam'addakkhiṃ, ko nu tvaṃ sāma jīvasi.
ahaṃ kho, ācariya, bahuñ'ca gaṇhāmi lahuñ'ca gaṇhāmi suṭṭhu ca upadhāremi, gahitañ'ca me na sammussati, satta ca me vassāni adhīyantassa, na'y'imassa sippassa anto paññāyati.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye pana ariyena paññācakkhunā samannāgatā, atha kho et'eva bahutarā sattā ye avijjāgatā sammuḷhā
etaṃ kho, bho gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammohavihārasmiṃ vadantī'ti? na kho, aggivessana, ettāvatā sammūḷho vā hoti asammūḷho vā.
yassa kassaci, aggivessana, ye āsavā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā appahīnā, tam'ahaṃ sammūḷho'ti vadāmi. āsavānañ'hi, aggivessana, appahānā sammūḷho hoti.

60924.meaning1: polite; cordial; speaking in a friendly manner
60924.commentary: (DNa) sammodako'ti paṭisanthārakusalo, āgat'āgatānaṃ catunnaṃ parisānaṃ, kacci, bhikkhave, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyan'ti-ādinā nayena sabbaṃ addhānadarathaṃ vūpasamento viya paṭhamataraṃ sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ kattā'ti attho.

examples.text: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo ehisvāgatavādī sakhilo sammodako abbhākuṭiko uttānamukho pubbabhāsī…

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udake lekhā khippaṃ'y'eva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo āgāḷhena'pi vuccamāno pharusena'pi vuccamāno amanāpena'pi vuccamāno sandhiyati'm'eva saṃsandati'm'eva sammodati'm'eva.
sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā daṇḍam'olubbha ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi
sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekam'antaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ

60928.meaning1: having exchanged pleasantries and concluded polite conversation

examples.text: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā daṇḍam'olubbha ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi
sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekam'antaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ

60929.meaning1: being friendly; being on good terms

examples.text: samet'āyasmā saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ek'uddeso phāsu viharatī'ti
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, manussā samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīr'odakībhūtā aññam'aññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, catuttho samayo padhānāya.

60931.meaning1: greeted; exchanged pleasantries; had a friendly conversation (with)
60931.commentary: (SNa) bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodī'ti yathā khamanīy'ādīni pucchanto bhagavā tena, evaṃ so'pi bhagavatā saddhiṃ samappavattamodo ahosi.

examples.text: atha kho verañjo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
atha kho te bhikkhū yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.

60932.meaning1: having mutually rejoiced; having delighted together (with)

examples.text: bhagavā tehi saddhiṃ sammoditvā kasmā, bhikkhave, upakaṭṭhāya vass'ūpanāyikāya vicarathā'ti pucchati.
tesaṃ ativelaṃ hassa-khiḍḍā-ratidhamma-samāpannānaṃ viharataṃ sati sammussati. satiyā sammosā te devā tamhā kāyā cavanti.
tassa ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno evaṃ carato evaṃ viharato kadāci karahaci satisammosā uppajjanti, pāpakā akusalā sarasaṅkappā saṃyojaniyā, dandho, bhikkhave, sat'uppādo
ime kho, kassapa, pañca okkamaniyā dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti.

n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yo evaṃ saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, pamādo. pamādo, bhikkhave, saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattatī'ti.
tass'eva kho pana pubbe aviddasuno avijjā hoti sammoho. sv'āssa pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tāl'āvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, bahiddhā asati paritassanā hotī'ti.

60936.grammar: aor of sammohaṃ āpajjati, comp vb, intrans

examples.text: kass'accayā na vijjanti, kassa n'atthi apāgataṃ, ko na sammoham'āpādi, ko ca dhīro sadā sato'ti.
tathāgatassa buddhassa, sabbabhūt'ānukampino, tass'accayā na vijjanti, tassa n'atthi apāgataṃ, so na sammoham'āpādi, so'va dhīro sadā sato'ti.

60937.meaning1: commentary to the Vibhaṅga, 2nd book of the Abhidhamma

60938.meaning1: living in delusion; ignorant mode of existence

examples.text: etaṃ kho, bho gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammohavihārasmiṃ vadantī'ti? na kho, aggivessana, ettāvatā sammūḷho vā hoti asammūḷho vā.
santi kho pana, brāhmaṇa, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā rattiṃ'y'eva samānaṃ divā'ti sañjānanti, divā'y'eva samānaṃ rattī'ti sañjānanti. idam'ahaṃ tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sammohavihārasmiṃ vadāmi.

60939.meaning1: resulting in bewilderment; with confusion as consequence
60939.commentary: (ANa) sammohavepakkan'ti sammohavipākaṃ. dukkhassa hi sammoho nissandavipāko nāma.

examples.text: sammohavepakkaṃ v'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ vadāmi pariyeṭṭhivepakkaṃ vā. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhassa vipāko.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco yena dukkhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati

tassa ce, bhikkhave, kulaputtassa evaṃ uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato te bhogā n'ābhinipphajjanti. so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati, moghaṃ vata me uṭṭhānaṃ, aphalo vata me vāyāmo'ti

yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, uddhaṅ'gamā vātā, adhogamā vātā, kucchisayā vātā, koṭṭhāsayā vātā, aṅgam'aṅg'ānusārino vātā, assāso passāso… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā vāyodhātu.
yo mahāmeruno kūṭaṃ, vimokkhena aphassayi, vanaṃ pubbavidehānaṃ, ye ca bhūmisayā narā.
yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ'va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, ajjhositaṃ saccamutaṃ paresaṃ. na tesu tādī sayasaṃvutesu, saccaṃ musā vā'pi paraṃ daheyya.

60943.meaning1: self-made; self-constructed; self-created; done by oneself
60943.meaning2: done by oneself, made by itself

examples.text: sayaṅ'kataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ… paraṅ'kataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ… sayaṅ'katañ'ca paraṅ'katañ'ca sukhadukkhaṃ… asayaṅ'kāraṃ aparaṅ'kāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti.

60944.meaning2: born from oneself, sprung up spontaneously

examples.text: na mandiyā sayāmi n'āpi kāveyyamatto, atthaṃ samecc'āham'apetasoko, eko vivitte sayan'āsanamhi, sayām'ahaṃ sabbabhūt'ānukampī.
so sayati evaṃ maṃ sayantaṃ n'ābhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssavissantī'ti
tasmā hi ne namasseyya, sakkareyya ca paṇḍito, annena atha pānena, vatthena sayanena ca, ucchādanena nhāpanena, pādānaṃ dhovanena ca.
evam'evaṃ te tiṇa-santhāraka-sayana-āsanaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa
ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, kālass'eva uṭṭhahanto'va sayanamhā pathaviṃ āmaseyyāsi
dassanaṃ me atikkante, sasaṅghe lokanāyake, sayanā vuṭṭhahitvāna, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujiṃ tadā.

60948.meaning1: talk about beds; discussion about furniture

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mah'āmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ

60949.meaning1: on a bed; lying down; gone to bed
60949.commentary: (VINa) sayanagatassā'ti antamaso kaṭasārake'pi pakatibhūmiyam'pi nipannassa ucce'pi mañcapīṭhe vā bhūmipadese vā ṭhitena nisinnena vā desetuṃ na vaṭṭati. sayanagatena pana sayanagatassa uccatare vā samappamāṇe vā nipannena desetuṃ vaṭṭati. nipannena ca ṭhitassa vā nisinnassa vā desetuṃ vaṭṭati, nisinnenā'pi ṭhitassa vā nisinnassa vā vaṭṭati. ṭhitena ṭhitass'eva vaṭṭati.

examples.text: na sayanagatassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na sayanagatassa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca antamaso chamāyam'pi nipannassa sayanagatassa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

60950.meaning1: wanting a bed; in need of a couch
60950.meaning2: who wants a bed; who is looking for a couch

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imāsaṃ pokkharaṇīnaṃ tīre evarūpaṃ dānaṃ paṭṭhapeyyaṃ, annaṃ ann'aṭṭhikassa, pānaṃ pān'aṭṭhikassa, vatthaṃ vatth'aṭṭhikassa, yānaṃ yān'aṭṭhikassa, sayanaṃ sayan'aṭṭhikassa, itthiṃ itthi'ṭṭhikassa, hiraññaṃ hiraññ'aṭṭhikassa, suvaṇṇaṃ suvaṇṇ'aṭṭhikassā'ti.

60951.meaning1: store of beds; collection of furniture
60951.commentary: (DNa) sayanasannidhimhi sayanan'ti mañco. ekassa bhikkhuno eko gabbhe, eko divāṭhāne'ti ukkaṃsato dve mañcā vaṭṭanti. tato uttari labhitvā aññassa bhikkhuno vā gaṇassa vā dātabbo, adātuṃ na vaṭṭati. sannidhi ca hoti, sallekhañ'ca kopeti.

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, annasannidhiṃ pānasannidhiṃ vatthasannidhiṃ yānasannidhiṃ sayanasannidhiṃ gandhasannidhiṃ āmisasannidhiṃ iti vā iti evarūpā sannidhikāraparibhogā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo'ti, iti vā hi, bhikkhave, puthujjano tathāgatassa vaṇṇaṃ vadamāno vadeyya.

60952.meaningLit: rule about (teaching the Dhamma to someone) lying down

examples.text: sukhajīvino pure āsuṃ, bhikkhū gotamasāvakā, anicchā piṇḍam'esanā, anicchā sayan'āsanaṃ, loke aniccataṃ ñatvā, dukkhass'antaṃ akaṃsu te.
ucc'āvacesu sayanesu, kīvanto tattha bheravā, yehi bhikkhu na vedheyya, nigghose sayan'āsane.

60954.commentary: (VIN 2.5.9.1) sayanigharaṃ nāma yattha katthaci rañño sayanaṃ paññattaṃ hoti, antamaso sāṇipākāraparikkhittam'pi. (VINa) sayanighare'ti sayaniyaghare.

examples.text: anikkhantarājake'ti rājā sayanigharā anikkhanto hoti. aniggataratanake'ti mah'esī sayanigharā anikkhantā hoti, ubho vā anikkhantā honti.
indakhīlo nāma sayanigharassa ummāro vuccati.
nasayanighare sayanigharasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. nasayanighare vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. nasayanighare nasayanigharasaññī, anāpatti.
sayaṃ samāhito nāgo, nisinno'pi samāhito, sabbattha saṃvuto nāgo, esā nāgassa sampadā.
udar'āvadehakaṃ bhutvā, sayant'uttānaseyyakā, kathaṃ vattenti paṭibuddhā, yā kathā satthugarahitā.
addasā kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyanto purisaṃ ābādhikaṃ dukkhitaṃ bāḷhagilānaṃ sake muttakarīse palipannaṃ sayamānaṃ aññehi vuṭṭhāpiyamānaṃ aññehi saṃvesiyamānaṃ.

60958.meaning1: just by oneself; on one's own accord

examples.text: yo attano sīlavatāni jantu, anānupuṭṭho'va paresa pāva, anariyadhammaṃ kusalā tam'āhu, yo ātumānaṃ sayam'eva pāva.
atisāradiṭṭhiyā'va so samatto, mānena matto paripuṇṇamānī, sayam'eva sāmaṃ manas'ābhisitto, diṭṭhī hi sā tassa tathā samattā.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā takkī hoti vīmaṃsī. so takkapariyāhataṃ vīmaṃs'ānucaritaṃ sayam'paṭibhānaṃ evam'āha, yaṃ kho idaṃ vuccati cakkhuṃ iti'pi sotaṃ iti'pi ghānaṃ iti'pi jivhā iti'pi kāyo iti'pi, ayaṃ attā anicco addhuvo asassato vipariṇāmadhammo.
saṃvaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassarasaṃvattanikā honti. te tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayam'pabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino, ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.

60964.meaning1: entrenched in a dogmatic view; enclosed in one's own opinion
60964.commentary: (ANa) sayasaṃvutesū'ti sayam'eva saṃvaritvā piyāyitvā gahitagahaṇesu, diṭṭhigatikesū'ti attho. diṭṭhigatikā hi sayaṃ saṃvutā'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ'va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, ajjhositaṃ saccamutaṃ paresaṃ. na tesu tādī sayasaṃvutesu, saccaṃ musā vā'pi paraṃ daheyya.

60965.meaning1: by one's own; oneself; one's own

examples.text: atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañ'ca lokaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī'ti
sakañ'hi diṭṭhiṃ katham'accayeyya, chand'ānunīto ruciyā niviṭṭho, sayaṃ samattāni pakubbamāno, yathā hi jāneyya tathā vadeyya.

60966.meaning1: self-made; self constructed; self-created; done by oneself
60966.meaning2: done by oneself, made by itself

examples.text: sant'āvuso sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti. santi pan'āvuso sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā kammavādā paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkhaṃ paññapenti.
ye rāgaratt'ānupatanti sotaṃ, sayaṃkataṃ makkaṭako'va jālaṃ, etam'pi chetvāna vajanti dhīrā, anapekkhino sabbadukkhaṃ pahāya.

idāni tīsu'pi dvāresu āyūhanacetanā samodhānetabbā. seyyath'idaṃ, kāyadvāre sayaṃkatamūlikā vīsati cetanā, āṇattimūlikā vīsati, sampajānamūlikā vīsati, asampajānamūlikā vīsatī'ti asīti cetanā honti, tathā vacīdvāre.

60968.meaning1: something self-made; action done by oneself
60968.commentary: (ADha) tattha attano dhammatāya kataṃ sayaṃkāraṃ' nāma. paraṃ karontaṃ disvā kataṃ paraṃkāraṃ' nāma.

examples.text: asayaṃkāro aparaṃkāro'ti n'atthi etassa sayaṃkāro'ti asayaṃkāro, n'atthi etassa parakāro'ti aparakāro. anunāsik'āgamaṃ katvā vuttaṃ aparaṃkāro'ti.

60970.meaning1: name of a town in Ceta

examples.text: takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃs'ānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ. yassa ca khv'āssa atthāya dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyā'ti.
te tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayaṃpabhā antalikkhecarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.

60974.commentary: (MNa) sayaṃvasī'ti paṭhamaṃ vejjassa vase vattamāno vejjena nisīdā'ti vutte nisīdi, nipajjā'ti vutte nipajji, bhuñjā'ti vutte bhuñji, pivā'ti vutte pivi, pacchā sayaṃvasī jāto.

examples.text: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto bhesajjaṃ kareyya. so taṃ bhesajjaṃ āgamma kuṭṭhehi parimucceyya, arogo assa sukhī serī sayaṃvasī yena kāmaṃ gamo.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gacchanto vā gacchāmī'ti pajānāti ṭhito vā ṭhito'mhī'ti pajānāti nisinno vā nisinno'mhī'ti pajānāti sayāno vā sayāno'mhī'ti pajānāti
tiṭṭhañ'caraṃ nisinno vā sayāno vā, yāvat'assa vigatamiddho, etaṃ satiṃ adhiṭṭheyya, brahmam'etaṃ vihāraṃ idha'm'āhu.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gacchanto vā gacchāmī'ti pajānāti, ṭhito vā ṭhito'mhī'ti pajānāti, nisinno vā nisinno'mhī'ti pajānāti, sayāno vā sayāno'mhī'ti pajānāti.

60981.commentary: (SNa) sukhasayitānī'ti cattāro māse koṭṭhe pakkhittaniyāmen'eva sukhaṃ sayitāni.

examples.text: imāni c'assu, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni akhaṇḍāni apūtikāni avāt'ātapahatāni sār'ādāni sukhasayitāni, pathavī ca n'āssa, āpo ca n'āssa, api nu'māni, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyun'ti?

60986.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
60986.commentary: (MNa) sayho anomanikkamo'ti sayho nāma so buddho, anomavīriyattā pana anomanikkamo'ti vutto.

examples.text: durannayo saṅgho atho'pi ujjayo, aparo muni sayho anomanikkamo, ānando nando upanando dvādasa, bhāradvājo antimadehadhārī.
sare hatthehi bhañjitvā, katvāna kuṭim'acchisaṃ, tena me sarabhaṅgo'ti, nāmaṃ sammutiyā ahu.
tassa kusakaṇṭakā c'eva pāde vijjheyyuṃ, sarapattāni ca gattāni vilekheyyuṃ.
dūre santo pakāsenti, himavanto'va pabbato, asant'ettha na dissanti, rattiṃ khittā yathā sarā.
sevamāno sevamānaṃ, samphuṭṭho samphusaṃ paraṃ, saro diddho kalāpaṃ'va, alittam'upalimpati. upalepabhayā dhīro, n'eva pāpasakhā siyā.
tassa na tādiso vaṇṇo hoti seyyathā'pi gunnaṃ, na tādiso saro hoti seyyathā'pi gunnaṃ, na tādisaṃ padaṃ hoti seyyathā'pi gunnaṃ.
tatra, bhikkhave, taramānassa bhāsato kāyo'pi kilamati, cittam'pi upahaññati, saro'pi upahaññati, kaṇṭho'pi āturīyati, avisaṭṭham'pi hoti aviññeyyaṃ taramānassa bhāsitaṃ.

samās'antagatānaṃ nāmānam'anto saro kvaci akāro hoti. devānaṃ rājā devarājo, devarājā, devānaṃ sakhā devasakho, devasakhā, pañca ahāni pañc'āhaṃ, satt'āhaṃ, pañcagavaṃ, chatt'upāhanaṃ, upasaradaṃ, visāl'akkho, vimukho.

hū'icc'etassa dhātussa saro eha oha ettam'āpajjate bhavissantimhi, ssassa ca lopo hoti vā. hehiti, hehinti, hohiti, hohinti, heti, henti, hehissati, hehissanti, hohissati, hohissanti, hessati, hessanti. hūti kim'atthaṃ? bhavissati, bhavissanti. bhavissantimhī'ti kim'atthaṃ? hoti.
tassa ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno evaṃ carato evaṃ viharato kadāci karahaci satisammosā uppajjanti, pāpakā akusalā sarasaṅkappā saṃyojaniyā, dandho, bhikkhave, sat'uppādo

60993.commentary: (SNa) kuto sarā nivattantī'ti ime saṃsārasarā kuto nivattanti, kiṃ āgamma nappavattantī'ti attho.

examples.text: kuto sarā nivattanti, kattha vaṭṭaṃ na vattati, kattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhatī'ti.

satta devā, satta mānusā, satta pesācā, satta sarā, satta pavuṭā, satta papātā, satta papātasatāni, satta supinā, satta supinasatāni, cullāsīti mahākappino satasahassāni, yāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti.

60995.meaning1: name of a Sakyan lay disciple

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sarakāni sakko kālaṅ'kato hoti. so bhagavatā byākato, sot'āpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo'ti.

60996.commentary: (ANa) sarakuttim'pi nikāmayamānassā'ti evaṃ gītassaro kātabbo'ti sarakiriyaṃ patthayamānassa.

examples.text: attanā'pi tasmiṃ sare sārajjati, pare'pi tasmiṃ sare sārajjanti, gahapatikā'pi ujjhāyanti, yath'eva mayaṃ gāyāma, evam'evaṃ kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā gāyantī'ti, sarakuttim'pi nikāmayamānassa samādhissa bhaṅgo hoti, pacchimā janatā diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati.

60997.meaning1: with monsters; with daemons; epithet of women
60997.commentary: (SNa) mātugāmavasena sagāhaṃ sarakkhasaṃ. vuttañ'h'etaṃ gāharakkhaso'ti kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmass'etaṃ adhivacanan'ti (itivu. 109). sesavāresu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: yo taṃ rūpamayaṃ vegaṃ sahati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atari cakkhusamuddaṃ saūmiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sagāhaṃ sarakkhasaṃ.
vātavuṭṭhisamayo nāma bhikkhū sarajena vātena okiṇṇā honti, dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni kāye patitāni honti, vātavuṭṭhisamayo'ti nahāyitabbaṃ.
āvilacitto anāvilaṃ, sarajo vītarajaṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ, sabbattha vimuttamānasaṃ, kiṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi.
